newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Likud official named Africa Israel director.
newsitem.headline: Likud official named Africa Israel director.

text.p: A close associate of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was appointed to the board of directors of Africa Israel Investments, one of Israel's leading conglomerates, the company said.
Izzi Tapuchi, an accountant, serves as Treasurer of Netanyahu's Likud party and is close to the prime minister, a party spokeswoman said.
The move paves the way for Tapuchi's expected appointment by the board as chairman of the company, reportedly next week.

Africa Israel is a subsidiary of government-controlled Bank Leumi, which must reduce its stake to 25 percent to comply with Israeli law. Leumi currently owns 65 percent of the voting rights in Africa Israel, which has interests in insurance, construction and hotels.
The insurance holdings will be spun off separately and Leumi has issued a tender for the sale of a controlling stake in the remaining part of Africa Israel.
